purpose: Bridge the gap between one fully known evaluator and universal per-component dominance by certifying Brain-minus-target noninferiority over every mixture consistent with independently proved component-delta and mixture-weight bounds.

theorem.uncertainty_set: For component i, delta_i is in [L_i,U_i], weight_i is in [a_i,b_i], all weights are nonnegative and sum to one. The runtime conservatively treats unresolved dependence between deltas and weights as the full Cartesian product.
theorem.lower_bound: min over the bounded simplex of sum_i w_i*L_i
theorem.upper_bound: max over the bounded simplex of sum_i w_i*U_i

strict_improvement_over_current_gdpval_d: A universal no-Opus-win condition for every task/judge cell is sufficient but not necessary. When sound aggregate component-delta intervals and judge-mixture bounds are available, some negative components can be tolerated if the exact worst admissible mixture remains nonnegative.
